violation_type.title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside (26 TAC §746.5207(a)(4))
violation_type.short_title: Emergency Evacuation and Relocation Diagram - Designated Location Inside
violation_type.typical_finding: The operation emergency plan is missing a designated location where all caregivers and children will relocate.

finding_variants.text: The operation emergency plan is missing a designated location where all caregivers and children will relocate.
The emergency evacuation and relocation diagram does not show the relocation area inside of the building.
The evacuation diagram was missing the designated location inside the operation for children and staff to meet to take shelter from threatening weather.
The operations emergency diagram did not include a designated location inside the child-care center where all caregivers and children take shelter from threatening weather.

The emergency diagram did not include the designated location inside the child-care center where all caregivers and children take shelter from threatening weather.     The deficiency was corrected during the inspection as this information was added to the diagram.
